name: Weed Snobs Diamond Infused Preroll | Pineapple Express
description: Pineapple Express is a sativa dominate strain that is a cross between Trainwreck and Hawaiian. It has flavors of pineapple, citrus, and other tropical fruits. This strain produces mostly happy, uplifted and energetic effects.
